scheme.usage: CSS color-scheme for each theme, so native controls (scroll bars, pop-ups) follow it.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Octet Blue: Logo Blue #213C99, from the master PSD. Primary buttons, active tool, links, brand text. Dark is the same hue and chroma at OKLCH L 0.70, for text on dark surfaces. Use on-brand for text on it.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills. Darkens on light, brightens on dark.

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Focus rings, the selection (its frame, handles and marks, unless Settings > General > Selection gives another colour), live snapping guides. The logo hue at the most chroma sRGB holds at OKLCH L 0.587. Not for text.

tokens.name: brand-mist
tokens.usage: Selected-tool background, active row, soft brand tint behind a panel. Brand text on it passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text-level brand accents: chosen options, text buttons, and text and icons on brand-mist. 4.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: Steps Dark Blue. Marketing footers, the ground for the white mark, strong accent blocks. Never a whole marketing section.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The drawing canvas. Pure white on light so exported figures match journal pages.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App chrome: toolbars, inspector, sidebars. Also the marketing page ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, floating palettes that sit above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inset wells: search fields, segmented control tracks, code and SMILES blocks.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers between panels and list rows. Decorative only.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Control borders and tracks (switches, check boxes, inputs, ghost buttons). Meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: swatch-edge
tokens.usage: The edge of a colour swatch. Strong in dark, so black and ink swatches keep a 3:1 edge on dark panels.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and default bond colour on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, inspector labels, inactive tool icons.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, keyboard shortcut hints. Still 4.5:1 on canvas and surface.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand fills: white on light, navy on dark (the dark brand is light).

tokens.name: tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltip fill, with on-tooltip text. Dark in both themes, a step above the dark chrome.

tokens.name: on-tooltip
tokens.usage: Text on the tooltip fill.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: The selection's tint: hover, lasso and marquee, and the band on the rulers. A selection colour from Settings takes the same opacities (src/selectcolour.ts SELECT_TINTS). Also the soft tint over a drop target.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: The dim behind dialogs, Settings and the command palette. Always darkens the window.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valence OK, structure saved, check passed.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unusual valence, unbalanced charge. Pair with an icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Impossible valence, failed parse of a name or SMILES.

tokens.name: atom-n
tokens.usage: Nitrogen labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-o
tokens.usage: Oxygen labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-s
tokens.usage: Sulfur labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-p
tokens.usage: Phosphorus labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-halogen
tokens.usage: F and Cl labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-br
tokens.usage: Bromine labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-i
tokens.usage: Iodine labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-b
tokens.usage: Boron labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-si
tokens.usage: Silicon labels when element colouring is on.

tokens.name: atom-metal
tokens.usage: Metal centres (Rh, Pd, Bi, Fe…) when element colouring is on.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing hero only. One per page.

styles.name: body

styles.name: ui

styles.name: smiles
styles.usage: SMILES, InChI, coordinates, any machine string.

styles.name: formula
styles.usage: Formula and mass readouts in the status bar and inspector.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, tight tool groups.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between toolbar buttons, inspector row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control inner padding, list row height rhythm.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between inspector sections, dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Marketing card padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Marketing gaps between blocks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Marketing section padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Tags, keyboard hint chips, small swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tool buttons, inputs, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, popovers, segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, marketing cards. Matches Steps buttons.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: App icon tile corner (Apple squircle approximation).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating tool palette, popovers, menus. The only elevation in the app.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on every control: solid brand-bright, 3:1 or more against every surface in both themes.

drawing.note: Default document style: ACS Document 1996, by the book. Users can pick another style. Export matches the page exactly.

tokens.name: bond-length
tokens.usage: Default bond length.

tokens.name: bond-width
tokens.usage: Line width for single, double and triple bonds.

tokens.name: bond-bold
tokens.usage: Bold bond and wedge wide-end width.

tokens.name: bond-spacing
tokens.usage: Double bond spacing as a share of bond length.

tokens.name: hash-spacing
tokens.usage: Spacing between hashes in a hashed wedge.

tokens.name: chain-angle
tokens.usage: Angle between bonds in a chain.

tokens.name: margin-width
tokens.usage: Gap between a bond end and an atom label.

tokens.name: atom-label-font
tokens.usage: Atom label font.

tokens.name: atom-label-size
tokens.usage: Atom label size.

tokens.name: caption-font
tokens.usage: Caption font.

tokens.name: caption-size
tokens.usage: Caption size.

tokens.name: arrow-head
tokens.usage: Arrowhead length on reaction and curly arrows.

motion.note: Short and soft: 150-200 ms, one ease-out curve, no bounce (one exception: the toolbar drop). Reduced motion turns movement off. Every transition and animation uses these, in CSS and in script.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Every fade, slide, hover and camera move. Starts fast, settles softly.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hovers, presses, strips and menus opening, and every overlay leaving.

tokens.name: motion
tokens.usage: Things that move across the window: the tool indicator, camera moves, the toolbar width, Home.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Dialogs, Settings and the tutorial card coming in; a settle into a new place.

tokens.name: ease-drop
tokens.usage: Only the toolbar drop (BRAND.md, Motion): the option settles into its slot with a small overshoot.

tokens.name: motion-drop
tokens.usage: Only the toolbar drop's settle and ripple.
